question: Use oc explain to inspect the Deployment API schema for spec.template.spec.containers.resources and spec.template.spec.nodeSelector. Explain how these fields relate to the observed scheduling failures of web-a and web-c in podpilot-test. Verify their actual specifications. Do not change anything.

result.answer:
## Findings

`oc explain` reports:

- `deployment.spec.template.spec.containers.resources` is a `ResourceRequirements` object. Its relevant maps are:
  - `requests`: resources requested by the container and used by the scheduler when placing the Pod.
  - `limits`: maximum resources allowed; a limit may also be copied as the request when no request is specified.
- `deployment.spec.template.spec.nodeSelector` is a `map[string]string`: the Pod can only be scheduled onto a node having every specified label/value pair.

## Verified specifications and failures

| Deployment | Actual pod-template field | Current result | Relationship to failure |
|---|---|---|---|
| `web-a` | `nodeSelector: {agentic-challenges.invalid/node-pool: nonexistent}`; CPU request `10m`, limit `100m`; memory request `32Mi`, limit `128Mi` | Pod `web-a-6ddbcd57df-kmvts` is Pending and unscheduled | The only node, `sno1`, does not have the requested selector label. Its `PodScheduled=False` message says: `0/1 nodes ... didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector`. The small resource request is not the reported blocker. |
| `web-c` | No `nodeSelector`; CPU request **`100`**, limit **`100`**; memory request `32Mi`, limit `128Mi` | Pod `web-c-75f9f6f5d6-vjtl5` is Pending and unscheduled | Kubernetes CPU quantity `100` means 100 CPU cores, not 100 millicores. The only node has `11500m` (11.5 CPUs) allocatable, so this request cannot fit. Its scheduling message says: `0/1 nodes ... Insufficient cpu`. |

Recent `FailedScheduling` events corroborate both causes; preemption was reported as not helpful. No changes were made.

reads.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf '%s\n' '=== oc explain deployment.spec.template.spec.containers.resources ==='
oc explain deployment.spec.template.spec.containers.resources
printf '%s\n' '=== oc explain deployment.spec.template.spec.nodeSelector ==='
oc explain deployment.spec.template.spec.nodeSelector
printf '%s\n' '=== Deployments: selected actual fields ==='
oc -n podpilot-test get deployment web-a web-c -o json | jq -r '.items[] | {name:.metadata.name, generation:.metadata.generation, observedGeneration:.status.observedGeneration, replicas:.spec.replicas, selector:.spec.selector.matchLabels, nodeSelector:(.spec.template.spec.nodeSelector // {}), containers:[.spec.template.spec.containers[] | {name,image,resources}]}'
printf '%s\n' '=== Pods owned via ReplicaSets ==='
for d in web-a web-c; do
  echo "--- $d ---"
  rs=$(oc -n podpilot-test get rs -o json | jq -r --arg d "$d" '.items[] | select(any(.metadata.ownerReferences[]?; .kind=="Deployment" and .name==$d)) | .metadata.name')
  if [ -z "$rs" ]; then echo 'No owned ReplicaSet observed'; continue; fi
  printf 'ReplicaSets: %s\n' "$rs"
  oc -n podpilot-test get pods -o json | jq -r --argjson rss "$(printf '%s\n' "$rs" | jq -R . | jq -s .)" '.items[] | select(.metadata.ownerReferences[]? | .kind=="ReplicaSet" and (.name as $n | $rss | index($n))) | {name:.metadata.name,uid:.metadata.uid,phase:.status.phase,nodeName:(.spec.nodeName // null),nodeSelector:(.spec.nodeSelector // {}),conditions:[.status.conditions[]? | select(.type=="PodScheduled") | {status,reason,message,lastTransitionTime}],containerRequests:[.spec.containers[]|{name,requests:(.resources.requests//{}),limits:(.resources.limits//{})}]}'
done
printf '%s\n' '=== Relevant recent Events ==='
oc -n podpilot-test get events --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp -o json | jq -r '[.items[] | select((.involvedObject.kind=="Pod" or .involvedObject.kind=="Deployment" or .involvedObject.kind=="ReplicaSet") and (.involvedObject.name|test("^web-(a|c)(-|$)"))) | {time:(.eventTime // .lastTimestamp // .metadata.creationTimestamp),type,reason,object:(.involvedObject.kind+"/"+.involvedObject.name),message,count}] | .[-30:][]'

set -euo pipefail
oc get nodes -o json | jq -r '.items[] | {name:.metadata.name, allocatableCPU:.status.allocatable.cpu, capacityCPU:.status.capacity.cpu, requestedSelectorLabel:(.metadata.labels["agentic-challenges.invalid/node-pool"] // null)}'

set -euo pipefail
printf '%s\n' '=== Deployment specs ==='
oc -n podpilot-test get deploy web-a web-c -o json | jq -c '.items[] | {deployment:.metadata.name, replicas:.spec.replicas, containers:[.spec.template.spec.containers[]|{name,image,resources}], nodeSelector:(.spec.template.spec.nodeSelector // {})}'
printf '%s\n' '=== Current owned pods and scheduling conditions ==='
for d in web-a web-c; do
  sel=$(oc -n podpilot-test get deploy "$d" -o jsonpath='{range $k,$v := .spec.selector.matchLabels}{$k}={$v},{end}' | sed 's/,$//')
